Module 01 Knowledge Check Quiz

This formative quiz consists of 10 multiple-choice questions covering Git version control principles, the Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) model, terminal workflows, and Unicode polytonic Greek encoding standards.

  • Format: 10 Multiple Choice Questions with diagnostic explanations
  • Attempts: Unlimited (highest grade counts toward module mastery)
  • Feedback: Detailed feedback provided immediately upon submission for every choice.
